Preserve every exact one of the seven labels, relative arrangement, main/secondary size hierarchy, path nodes, one reference arrow, palette and theme/size distinction. No extra wording, border or background. All visible content needs a generous white safety area; no mark may extend inside 60px of an edge.
EDIT the provided moth asset-anatomy illustration. REMOVE the complete article headline at the top, the entire prose paragraph beneath it, and the whole prose footer at the bottom. Those are NOT allowed artwork text. Preserve only these SEVEN exact labels, each once: ["Approved reference","Editable paths","Light and dark","Same SVG","Small-size check","State destination","Examples, not quality proof"]. No other letters, numbers, paragraphs, attribution or article wording. Reflow the remaining radial mechanism to fill the middle of a white 1200x630 canvas with all glyphs, marks and moths at least 60–72px inside every edge. Keep the large central editable moth with its meaningful path edit nodes, the smaller approved-reference moth at upper left, the tiny-size version below, and the paired theme checks at upper right. Put the dark-theme moth on a single dark navy test swatch and the light-theme moth on a pale test swatch, so Light and dark is visibly demonstrated, with the SAME moth geometry in both and palette differences only. Place Same SVG next to that paired theme test, not below the unrelated central wing. Keep the one reference-to-editable-moth arrow. Editable paths may have a nondirectional leader to a real edit node. Remove the lines to Examples, not quality proof and State destination; both are detached open-margin notes, not effects of the moth. Do not add arrowheads or diagrams. Preserve flat color-woodcut craft and clear contour layers. No simulated writing, UI, logos, photography, decorative dots or text blocks. The single supported relationship is source-specific reference to editable paths, then nondirectional checks of theme and small size.
